domain-information: A restaurant manager reviews reservations to plan tables for the evening.
A restaurant manager checks inventory levels to ensure ingredients are available for the menu.
A restaurant manager reviews supplier delivery reports to confirm restocking of essential items.
A restaurant manager designs the menu and its meals.
A host greets arriving customers and checks their reservation.
A host assigns guests to available tables and updates the reservations.
A host informs servers when a new table has been seated.
A guest looks through the menu to chose a meal.
A server registers meal orders from guests into the order queue.
A server delivers prepared meals to guests.
A server forwards customer feedback about meals to the restaurant manager.
A chef reviews incoming orders in the order queue from the servers to plan meal preparation.
A chef assigns cooking tasks to kitchen staff.
A chef notifies servers when meals are ready to be served.
A kitchen staff member prepares ingredients according to the day’s menu.
A kitchen staff member updates the inventory record when ingredients are used.
A supplier delivers ordered ingredients and confirms the delivery with the restaurant manager.

domain objects.name: Restaurant Manager
domain objects.description: Oversees restaurant operations, menu design, and supply management.

domain objects.name: Reservation
domain objects.description: A booking that secures a table for a guest.

domain objects.name: Table
domain objects.description: A physical seating area assigned to guests.

domain objects.name: Inventory
domain objects.description: Tracks ingredient quantities and availability.

domain objects.name: Ingredient
domain objects.description: A food item or material used in meal preparation.

domain objects.name: Inventory Record
domain objects.description: A log entry documenting ingredient usage or stock updates.

domain objects.name: Menu
domain objects.description: A collection of meals available to guests.

domain objects.name: Meal
domain objects.description: A dish offered on the menu, composed of ingredients.

domain objects.name: Host
domain objects.description: Greets guests and manages reservations and seating.

domain objects.name: Server
domain objects.description: Takes orders, delivers meals, and communicates with guests.

domain objects.name: Meal Order
domain objects.description: A request placed by a guest for specific meals.

domain objects.name: Guest
domain objects.description: A customer dining at the restaurant.

domain objects.name: Customer Feedback
domain objects.description: Guest comments on meals or service quality.

domain objects.name: Order Queue
domain objects.description: A list of pending meal orders awaiting kitchen processing.

domain objects.name: Chef
domain objects.description: Supervises meal preparation and coordinates kitchen staff.

domain objects.name: Cooking Task
domain objects.description: An assigned kitchen duty for preparing specific dishes.

domain objects.name: Kitchen Staff Member
domain objects.description: Prepares ingredients and assists in cooking.

domain objects.name: Meal Notification
domain objects.description: Alert to servers that a meal is ready to be served.

domain objects.name: Supplier
domain objects.description: Delivers ingredients and goods to the restaurant.

domain objects.name: Ingredient Order
domain objects.description: A purchase request sent to a supplier for ingredients.

associations.description: Designs and updates the restaurant menu.
Fulfills ingredient orders from the restaurant.
Greets and assigns guests to tables.
Updates reservations based on table assignments.
Places an order for selected meals.
Provides feedback on meals or service.
Feedback is received by the server.
Forwards meal orders to the kitchen queue.
Assigns preparation work to kitchen staff.
